purpose: 各レアリティに8種類以上の手スキンを揃える追加38種。既存スキンは保持。
basePrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset: ONE isolated LEFT HAND game cursor skin on genuine transparent alpha background. Back of hand facing viewer, four distinct fingers pointing upward plus thumb on image RIGHT, wrist at bottom center. EXACTLY five digits, elegant relaxed near-parallel fingers, anatomical readability. Whole fingertips and short wrist visible. Square PNG, hand occupies 88-92% height, about 45-55% width, centered. No text, no labels, no frame, no scene, no floor, no cast shadow outside hand, no held object, no stone, no extra hands. Polished semi-realistic fantasy game illustration, exquisite material rendering and soft studio lighting, crisp alpha silhouette. Transparent background must not be simulated with black or drawn checkerboard. Each is a distinct hand design, not a card illustration. Subject:
